messages.author: b8c66039106161bf
messages.subject: geom_boxplot() error in R 2.9.0
parts:
Hi,
after having trouble running geom_boxplot() with my own data, I've
realised that the example from the website now also returns the same
error:

p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(factor(cyl), mpg))
p + geom_boxplot()

Error in data.frame(numeric(0), numeric(0), c(10.4, 10.4, 19.2),
check.names = FALSE, :
arguments imply differing number of rows: 0, 3

I suspect this may have something to do with the way they changed the
behaviour of loops over factor levels in v2.9.0...

cheers
Mikhail
